messages:
sarah.partnerships: Quick q — we've got 3 marketplace-introduced leads this week that overlap with SI-originated opportunities. Can we land on a simple gate so we don't both nurture the same account? :thinking:
liam.si_eng: Ugh, saw that too. Current pain is when SI does a pre-sales intro and SDR later 'claims' via intake form. We need order-of-ops: who gets first right to engage?
elaine.revops: suggest rule: first inbound touch wins for 14 days unless explicit handoff in SFDC. We can codify with a flag. Also need marketplace listing -> SFDC mapping to be deterministic.
tom.sales: +1 to a short TTL. Practical ask: if SI registers an account via channel X, they should set "SI-registered" checkbox and enter partner case id. Otherwise SDR owns.
jordan.product: For joint announcements we also care about timing — if partner wants a co-announce, that should lock the account from unilateral marketplace promos for 30 days. Otherwise we'll fracture messaging.
sarah.partnerships: OK, so two separate but related gates: 1) lead ownership TTL when SI does first touch (14d), 2) announcement lock (30d) if co-announce requested. Need field names and a small ingestion rule.
elaine.revops: Proposed fields on SFDC / intake: `si_claimed_by`, `si_claim_ts`, `coannounce_requested` (Y/N), `coannounce_lock_until`. Intake webhook should set these from marketplace API when a partner claim happens.
liam.si_eng: That works. On the SI side we'll add a tiny checkbox in our partner portal that posts to intake: `si_claimed=true` and partner_case_id. Marketplace-bot will also emit a message to #partnerships when claims happen.
marketplace-bot: [automated] New claim created: partner="NorthBridge" account="Acme Data" partner_case_id=NB-4523 timestamp=1737778001
sarah.partnerships: Nice. Can we also add a lightweight adjudication flow if SDR and SI both claim within 48h? e.g., auto-escalate to a partner ops triage queue.
tom.sales: Yes please. Last time we lost a week because nobody escalated. A triage ping to @sdr-leads + @si-ops should suffice.
elaine.revops: I'll draft the process and the minimal SFDC mapping today. Sample rules (pseudo):
```
if si_claimed_by and not coannounce_requested:
  ownership = SI for 14 days
elif coannounce_requested:
  ownership = joint and marketing_lock = 30 days
elif multiple_claims_within_48h:
  ownership = triage_queue
else:
  ownership = SDR
```
I'll put the exact field names in the intake spec.
jordan.product: We should also update our marketplace listing UI to show "Claimed by <partner> — contact: name@partner" so SDRs see it before they reach out. That would prevent accidental duplicate touches.
sarah.partnerships: Good UX note. Action items: Elaine to publish intake spec + SFDC field names by EOD, Liam to add portal webhook (partner-side) next week, Jordan to add listing banner to marketplace backlog, Tom to adjust SDR playbook to honor flags. I'll schedule a 30m sync Thu to ratify.
liam.si_eng: I'll block time Thu. Also will throw in a small script to reconcile historical overlaps for last 60 days so we can surface problem accounts.
marketplace-bot: [automated] Meeting scheduled by sarah.partnerships: Thu 11:00am PT — channel #partnerships (invites sent)
sarah.partnerships: Thanks all :thumbsup: We'll aim for a minimal, enforceable rule set rather than policy novels. If anyone has a hard constraint (legal/commercial) shout now.
tom.sales: No legal constraints on our end. Commercially, if a partner has reserved co-sell rights in a contract, we need an override flag — Elaine can add `contract_override=true`.
elaine.revops: noted — will include `contract_override` with audit trail. Draft will include examples + one-liner for SDR playbook.
sarah.partnerships: perfect. Closing thread — see invites, please add quick notes to the meeting doc if you can't make it.
